steps.title: Prepare Sabouraud Dextrose Broth
steps.instruction: Dissolve 30 g Sabouraud dextrose broth (Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #S3306) in 1 L MilliQ water, stir on a heated magnetic stirrer for 5 min at mid temperature/speed, cover flask with glass wool and aluminium foil, autoclave at 121 °C for 30 min, then allow to cool.

steps.title: Aliquot Medium and Label Tube
steps.instruction: Transfer 25 mL of the cooled medium into a tube and label the tube with the strain number.

steps.title: Inoculate Tube with Dermatophyte Culture
steps.instruction: Using a sterile swab or inoculation loop, gently collect the primary culture, dip it into the tube containing the medium, and close the tube halfway to allow gas exchange.

steps.title: Incubate for Flocculate Formation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 30 °C until a visible flocculate forms (minimum 96 h, typically 5 days). If no flocculate appears, repeat the cultivation step.

steps.title: Harvest Flocculate and Add Lysis Solution
steps.instruction: Using a Pasteur pipette, remove the flocculate, transfer it to a sterile tube containing glass beads (primary tube), and add 500 µL Cell Lysis Solution for Genomic Purification (Promega, Catalog #A7933).

steps.title: Perform Freeze‑Thaw‑Disruption Cycles
steps.instruction: Cool the tube on an ice block at –20 °C for 1 min, then heat in a water bath at 70 °C for 1 min, then run through a cell disruptor at maximum speed for 1 min. This three‑step cycle constitutes one round; repeat the cycle 5 times to obtain the primary lysate.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and Buffer BQ1
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of the primary lysate to a clean tube, add 25 µL proteinase K and 200 µL lysis buffer BQ1, vortex for 15 s, then incubate at 70 °C for 15 min in a water bath.

steps.title: Add Ethanol and Short‑Spin
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL absolute ethanol (96‑100 %), vortex for 15 s, then short‑spin centrifuge at 11 100 × g for a maximum of 10 s (temperature not specified) to accelerate protein precipitation; do not exceed this time.

steps.title: Transfer Supernatant to Silica Column
steps.instruction: Gently collect the supernatant (~600 µL) and apply it to a chromatographic column containing a silica membrane.

steps.title: Bind DNA by Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 11 100 × g for 1 min (temperature not specified) to allow DNA to bind to the silica membrane; keep the column and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash Column with Buffer BQ2 (350 µL)
steps.instruction: Place the column in a new collection tube, add 350 µL Buffer BQ2, and centrifuge at 11 100 × g for 3 min (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Wash Column with Buffer BQ2 (200 µL)
steps.instruction: Place the column in a new collection tube (or discard the previous flow‑through), add 200 µL Buffer BQ2, and centrifuge at 11 100 × g for 1 min (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Dry Column by Final Spin
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through or change the collection tube, then centrifuge the column at 11 100 × g for 1 min (temperature not specified) without adding any buffer.

steps.title: Elute DNA with Pre‑heated Buffer
steps.instruction: Place the column in a clean collection tube, add 50 µL elution buffer pre‑heated to 70 °C.

steps.title: Incubate, Elute, and Store DNA
steps.instruction: Incubate the column at room temperature for 5 min, then centrifuge at 11 100 × g for 1 min (temperature not specified); discard the column, keep the eluate (purified DNA), and store DNA at –80 °C for stability.

steps.title: Prepare Negative Control for NanoDrop
steps.instruction: Prepare a negative control by performing the entire extraction protocol without adding any dermatophyte material; this control will undergo all steps but contain no fungal DNA.

steps.title: Measure Blank and Sample on NanoDrop
steps.instruction: Launch the NanoDrop software, select nucleic acid mode, ensure the sample spot is clean and dry, apply 2 µL of the negative control and click “blank”. Then apply 2 µL of the DNA sample and click “measure” (no new blank needed between measurements).
